placements.why: No existing strata category covers organizational preparedness/disaster-recovery practice. This envelope's content — a mandated monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas rollbacks, with an owner assigned — is the first content in this repo naming that category: an operational-capability domain that future envelopes (rehearsal outcomes, cadence changes, other DR drills) will keep feeding.
placements.title: operational resilience becomes an actively rehearsed discipline, not a documented plan
placements.frame: Does this organizational content concern the maintenance of recovery/continuity capability through recurring, verifiable practice rather than static documentation?

placements.title: a capability's existence is proven by rehearsing it, not by declaring it
placements.frame: Does the rehearsal cadence for this capability actually run on schedule, and does what gets rehearsed match what is claimed as recoverable?
placements.why: src-1 mandates monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals and seals it with an aphorism collapsing 'unrehearsed' into 'nonexistent' — a durable claim about what makes a capability real, not a one-time fact. src-2 and src-3 restate the same commitment as structured fields (cadence, owner), evidencing the same theme in flat register rather than stating an independent fact. Together they name a subject — rehearsal as the condition of genuine readiness — that future envelopes about DR drills, rehearsal completions or misses, and ownership changes will keep feeding; no existing leaf holds this (the graph is currently empty) and it clears the grain test as a theme rather than a measurement.
